page_title: FlyEnv - Open Source Local Development Environment for AI Agents

sources.entry: FlyEnv - Local development environment manager for languages, databases, and services. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/xpf0000/FlyEnv)

summary.name: FlyEnv
summary.one_liner: FlyEnv is an open-source local development workspace for AI agents and developers, managing runtimes, databases, web servers, local sites, HTTPS and MCP on macOS, Windows and Linux.
use_cases: Running Laravel, WordPress or Django projects locally
Giving an AI coding agent a local environment to run and test projects
Replacing XAMPP or Docker for local PHP development
Switching Node.js, PHP or Python versions per project
Setting up local domains with HTTPS for development sites
Running a local stack of databases and services with one click
summary.what_it_does: FlyEnv installs and manages language runtimes (PHP, Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Flutter), databases (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse) and web servers (Nginx, Apache, Caddy, FrankenPHP) directly on the host OS without a container layer. It creates local sites with domains and HTTPS. Runtime versions can be set per project, and services can be grouped into startup groups that start together. The page says it connects AI coding agents to the local environment through MCP, letting them set up a project and provide a working local URL. It also lists developer tools such as phpMyAdmin, pgAdmin 4, Mailpit, MinIO and RabbitMQ.
notable: Open source, with code available on GitHub
Runs native services on the host OS without Docker or a container layer
Installs only the runtimes and services a project needs, with per-project version switching
Connects AI coding agents to a local environment through MCP
caveats: Free tier has limits: 3 local sites, 3 custom projects per runtime, 1 Cloudflare Tunnel, and a 3-day trial for built-in tools
Pro License is a one-time $10 payment that removes usage limits; it is listed as one active device
Some AI, Screenshot and Image Optimizer features are limited in the free tier
